advice: Abstain. The NN kernel already uses one SME streaming region for the full call. It clears ZA before each independent output tile, which is required for beta-zero results. The supplied evidence shows no distinct legal change to streaming entry, exit, or ZA setup that supports a useful hypothesis.
risks: Splitting the call would add streaming transitions. Removing ZA clears would mix results between output tiles. Neither change has evidence of benefit. Any future proposal must measure the complete gemm call with fresh paired controls; the supplied instruction listings do not isolate transition or ZA setup costs.
